content.title: Parker Hannifin Hits Record High After Acquisition, As This Often Overlooked Industry Gets Another Boost
content.summary: Parker Hannifin shares climbed to an all-time high Tuesday after the company announced it agreed to acquire privately held Filtration Group for $9.25 billion.  The deal adds to Parker's industrial offerings and creates one of the largest global industrial filtration businesses.  Parker Hannifin plans to fold the business into its industrial and aerospace products segment.
